description: VERIFIER output for the /deep-audit-run adversarial verify stage (DR-1). The verifier is CLAIM-BLIND: it is given a code location + the lens charter but NEVER the finder's claim, and describes what the code actually does there. A separate deterministic adjudication step (SKILL.md step 5) scores the stored finder claim against this evidence — the verifier never sees the proposition it would otherwise just echo. Its own file per the OPS-12 standing rule. Cross-model, kill-mandate, and the promote/refute decision table are defined in SKILL.md — not restated here.

locationConfirmed.description: Whether an error-handling / control-flow construct actually exists at the cited location (a finding pointing at nothing is refuted downstream).

controlFlow.description: Observed control flow at and around the cited location, described from a fresh read — branches, early returns, loops, the construct's actual behaviour.

errorHandling.description: How an error arising at the cited location is actually handled, by direct observation. 'swallowed' = caught and neither rethrown nor surfaced; 'none-present' = no error path exists here; 'unclear' = the read could not determine it (drives a refuted default).

reachableOutcomes.description: What states the code can reach from here, including any degraded state that nothing surfaces — or an explicit statement that failures are surfaced.

mechanicalChecks.description: Results of any mechanical confirmation run first where the claim class is mechanically checkable (e.g. grep/AST for a bare except|catch at the cited block). Empty array if none applied.

uncertainty.description: The verifier's confidence in this evidence. Adjudication defaults to REFUTED on medium/high uncertainty (kill-mandate).

notes.description: Anything else observed that bears on whether this location can hide a failure, or null.
